title: Repeated-station E. coli — sampling-calendar and depth-aware comparisons, 2021–2025
sections: What changes when the same sampled months are compared?

This chapter compares original routine E. coli observations at the same station and analytical method. It describes sampled concentrations, not annual loads, compliance status, model validation or an intervention effect.

sections: Four sampled-year comparisons reverse direction after restriction to shared calendar months and equal month weighting. This identifies sensitivity to observed sampling support; it does not establish which estimate represents an annual population.

The original calendar grouping has 17 identical-month pairs. Exact measurement support also retains recorded depth, fraction, medium, value type, QA and collection method, producing 13 identical-month pairs. A blank depth is not assigned the 0.3 m depth recorded on other samples.
Four actual direction reversals

These four comparisons use APHA 9223-B and original MPN/100mL units. Within each comparison, all exact measurement-support fields match; sampling depth is unreported on the included rows. Source records with a declared depth remain separate.

Matching a month name does not match sample dates, times, flow, weather or depth. The retained row locators allow those original distinctions to be reviewed before a more specific comparison is selected.

sections: 71 original rows carry an Information Only comment; 17 of those original rows occur in the repeated-year measurement groups. They remain included and flagged. This is an explicit all-routine source comparison, not a laboratory acceptance decision.

The one Quality Control Sample-Field Replicate remains in the original CSV and retained record index, outside routine means. Not Reported and ambiguous/missing limits never become zero, half a limit or a numeric measurement.
All 49 support definitions, daily means, month means, original comments and row identities are available in the numeric companion.
Calculation and decision use

For one exact support group, all original routine activities on a publisher date receive equal weight in its daily interval mean. Daily means receive equal weight in the all-sampled-day comparison. For common-month comparison, daily means first receive equal weight within each month, then only month numbers observed in both years receive equal weight across years.

The comparison is later minus earlier. For intervals, the lower difference is the later lower endpoint minus the earlier upper endpoint; the upper difference is the later upper endpoint minus the earlier lower endpoint. An endpoint remains open when a contributing endpoint is open. The source's nonnegative concentration floor is explicitly zero.

A below-reporting or below-quantitation result is retained as [0, original limit). A result above its upper quantitation limit is retained as (original limit, +∞). A reported number with no censor condition is a point. Unknown combinations remain unresolved; a full-support mean is unavailable if any contributing interval is unresolved.

Shared-month weighting answers a narrower sampled-calendar question. It cannot supply unmeasured months, adjust for hydrology, remove reporting bias or estimate uncertainty. Neither full-date nor common-month mean is labeled an annual time-weighted concentration or a native nutrient/sediment export.

For Monitoring, use the original calendar and winter scenario to identify where more comparable seasonal observations are needed. These results alone do not assign a new station, choose an intervention, establish a trend or alter programme costs.

sections: The six original agency CSV responses are retained as companions. The producer checks each selected original row against its unchanged response fields before calculation. Original dates, clock text, time zones, units, methods and source identifiers remain unchanged.

comparison_selection.date_basis: Unchanged publisher sample date; original clock and timezone retained, not converted.
comparison_selection.original_unit_policy: Exact result unit, or exact limit unit for a censored row; spelling variants are separate.
comparison_selection.qa_policy: Original result-status and qualifier labels remain separate. Information Only comments are counted and preserved, not silently excluded.
comparison_selection.weighting: Equal original activities within a date; equal sampled dates within a month; equal common calendar months across each pair of years.
comparison_selection.contrast: Later sampled period minus earlier sampled period; no intervention/control or annual population trend inferred.
